gloss: each section; each department; each part

definitions.gloss: each section; each department; all departments
definitions.explanation: Every department or division within an organization. Used in business and organizational contexts.
Every individual part or component of a machine, structure, or system.

examples.japanese: {各部|かくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
{各部|かくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表者|だいひょうしゃ}→代表者：03116_daihyousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}した→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
examples.english: Representatives from each department attended the meeting.

examples.japanese: {各部|かくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to review the budget of each department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{各部|かくぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To inspect each part of the machine.
I have pain in various parts of my body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{各部|かくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名称|めいしょう}→名称：12031_meishou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check the names of each part of the building in the diagram.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧ (each, every) and ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (section, department, part). A formal compound used in organizational and technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各部|かくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧: representative of each department
- {各部|かくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通達|つうたつ}→通達：22238_tsuutatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to notify all departments
- {各部|かくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名称|めいしょう}→名称：12031_meishou⟧: name of each part
- {各部|かくぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to inspect each part

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {各課|かくか}: each section/division — ⟦{課|か}→課：01548_ka⟧ is a smaller organizational unit than ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧
- {各部門|かくぶもん}: each division — similar but more formal
- ⟦{各所|かくしょ}→各所：16088_kakusho⟧: each place / various places — for locations rather than departments

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in business communications, technical manuals, and official documents.
